pixelOrigin: upper-left; x increases right; y increases down
method: Manual coarse trace of numbered source-map units, following the visible red separators and grey/green historical built-up perimeter. Green stroke width and indistinct road-side choices are interpreted approximately.

units.name: Hagyományos beépítésű belső lakóterület
units.note: Historical surrounding inner residential unit; the concave trace leaves Belváros, the separately numbered housing estates and their visible separators outside. Cadastral road 2606 is unresolved at street-side precision.

units.name: Herényi kertváros
units.note: Numbered historical garden-city unit north of Kámoni kertváros; perimeter follows Perint, the garden-city street divider and the historical built-up edge, rather than the full modern Herény polygon.

units.name: Kámoni kertváros
units.note: Numbered historical garden-city unit; northern and eastern historical built-up edges and cadastral roads 768 and 1636/5 are taken from the coarse overview map, not equated to the municipality or modern Kámon boundary.

units.name: Oladi kertváros
units.note: Historical unit 9 west of Oladi lakótelep and the Perint/lake corridor, south to the Homok/Jégpince divider. This includes source-period garden-city land beyond modern Olad's village core.

units.name: Alsóhegy-Középhegy kertváros
units.note: Combined historical unit 10 is traced as one source-defined area, without copying either modern Alsóhegy or Középhegy. Pap-árok and Külső Pozsonyi street-side inclusion remains approximate.

units.name: Újperint kertváros
units.note: Historical unit 11 between Pap-árok, Külső Pozsonyi/Körmendi route and the source-period built-up edge. It is distinct in source extent from modern Újperint.

units.name: Gyöngyösszőlős kertváros
units.note: Historical unit 12, east of separately numbered KISZ estate; its stepped housing-street edge and southern undeveloped/built-up limit are coarse map estimates. Modern Gyöngyösszőlős was not substituted.

units.name: Gyöngyöshermán kertváros
units.note: Source unit 13 between the two rail corridors, road 86 and the historical built-up edge. The source scheme predates later development and differs from the modern place polygon.

units.name: Szentkirály kertváros
units.note: Full numbered source-map unit 14 east of the railway, extending through the historically grouped eastern settlements; annex text supplies only the railway and the map supplies the remaining perimeter. Not aliased to the smaller modern Szentkirály village.

units.name: Ipartelep
units.note: Historical broad industrial unit 16. The separately numbered Éhen Gyula kertváros is removed using its archived documentary street trace; the source map resolves the unreadable road-number part of the annex. Broad mixed land use is intentional in this historical source-defined unit.
